# swarm-eod-agent

Engineering workspace for a multi-drone explosive ordnance disposal (EOD)
competition built on the `swarm-rescue` simulator (version 5.1.3 as supplied
by the competition organizer).

* The repository root is the competition baseline exactly as supplied; its own
  [README](../README.md) describes the upstream simulator.
* This project's documentation starts at [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md);
  provenance and licensing are in [docs/PROVENANCE.md](../docs/PROVENANCE.md).
* The upstream simulator is Swarm-Rescue by Emmanuel Battesti, MIT licensed
  (see [LICENSE](../LICENSE)). This repository is not a mirror of upstream or of
  the organizer's distribution, and it is not affiliated with either.
